image_location_description: Bottom of image; not shown, but a small black/DBG base under the feet for stability.

steps.title: Start core plates
steps.description: Place 2x Plate 2x2 (3022) Black in a 2x4 rectangle.

steps.title: Add front corners
steps.description: Attach 2x Plate Corner 2x2 (2780) Black at the front left/right.

steps.title: Square the rear
steps.description: Attach 1x Plate Corner 2x2 (2780) Black centered at the rear.

steps.title: Fill edges + stiffen
steps.description: Add 4x Plate 1x2 (3040b) Black to fill gaps; add 1x Plate 1x4 (3633) Black under center.

steps.title: Foot pads (DBG)
steps.description: On top, place 2x Tile 2x2 (2458) Dark Bluish Gray where feet will stand.

steps.title: Tile the perimeter
steps.description: Add 5x Tile 1x2 (2412b) Black around edges, leaving foot studs open.

steps.title: Finish top tiling
steps.description: Add 2x Tile 1x2 (2412b) Black + 1x Tile 1x2 (30089b) Black to close gaps.
